mapper.select: SELECT p.cntrct_ty_cd, p.use_yn, p.cur_cntrct_amt, coalesce(p.prfm_bgn_dt,p.cntrct_bgn_dt) AS begin_date, coalesce(p.cur_end_dt,p.cntrct_end_dt) AS end_date FROM prj.prj p WHERE p.prj_id=#{id}
SELECT l.aloc_stg_cd FROM prj.tk_aloc_line l WHERE l.prj_id=#{id} ORDER BY CASE l.aloc_stg_cd WHEN 'ACTUAL' THEN 3 WHEN 'FINAL' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM prj.cntrct_chg_hist h WHERE h.prj_id=#{id} AND h.cntrct_chg_stts_cd='CONFIRM' AND h.realoc_need_yn='Y') THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END

SELECT l.aloc_line_id,l.line_ty_cd,l.dev_id,l.item_nm,l.job_cd, l.asgn_bgn_dt,l.asgn_se_cd,l.rmrk_desc,l.sort_seq FROM prj.tk_aloc_line l WHERE l.prj_id=#{id} AND l.aloc_stg_cd=#{stage} ORDER BY l.sort_seq,l.aloc_line_id
SELECT m.aloc_ym,m.aloc_amt,m.mm_qty FROM prj.tk_aloc_mth m WHERE m.aloc_line_id=#{id} ORDER BY m.aloc_ym
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mst.dev d WHERE d.dev_id=#{id} AND d.use_yn='Y')
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cmn.cd_dtl d JOIN cmn.cd_grp g ON g.cd_grp_id=d.cd_grp_id WHERE d.cd_grp_id=#{group} AND d.dtl_cd=#{code} AND d.use_yn='Y' AND g.use_yn='Y')
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM prj.tk_aloc_mth m USING prj.tk_aloc_line l WHERE m.aloc_line_id=l.aloc_line_id AND l.prj_id=#{id} AND l.aloc_stg_cd=#{stage}
DELETE FROM prj.tk_aloc_line WHERE prj_id=#{id} AND aloc_stg_cd=#{stage}
mapper.update: UPDATE prj.cntrct_chg_hist SET realoc_need_yn='N' WHERE prj_id=#{id} AND realoc_need_yn='Y'
